content.snl: %The current implementation serializes only name and children. It does not write back style, envMode, binder prefixes, kind, scope, or mdata, so it is not a general lossless round trip.%
content.markdown: The current implementation serializes only `name` and `children`. It does not write back `style`, `envMode`, binder prefixes, `kind`, `scope`, or `mdata`, so it is not a general lossless round trip.
